subject: Literature
title: A Midsummer Night's Dream and Comic Magic
description: One-minute skill: A Midsummer Night's Dream and Comic Magic.

hook.text: Four lovers, a fairy king, and a man with a donkey's head collide in a forest of magical chaos.

buildup.text: A Midsummer Night's Dream layered three separate plots that tangled together through fairy mischief.

discovery.text: The love potion scenes showed how irrational desire is, making lovers switch affections in an instant.

twist.text: Shakespeare gave the most beautiful poetry to fairies and the worst acting to human performers within the play.

climax.text: The play proved that comedy could be as artistically ambitious as tragedy, with equal depth and skill.

punchline.text: The funniest play was also the most magical.

quiz.question: What does A Midsummer Night's Dream reveal about love?
options: Love is always rational and predictable
Desire is irrational and can switch affections instantly
True love always conquers fairy magic
